description: Otter.ai is a meeting transcription and notes platform with a REST API for channels, conversations, transcripts, and workspace data.
access_notes: The Public API is available only to Enterprise workspaces ('If you do not see this feature for your workspace, contact your Otter account manager'); it is not available on lower-tier plans and is not self-serve outside Enterprise.
api_notes: Channels, conversations, transcripts, audio, action items, insights, outlines, workspace details, and webhooks.
main_blocker: Public API access is restricted to Enterprise workspace plans.
